consensus_summary: Fans have mixed feelings about the performance, with some praising the energy and unique moments in the second set, while others criticize the overall execution and missed cues. Highlights include a standout 'When I Paint My Masterpiece' and an emotional 'Black Peter', but many noted Jerry's struggles with lyrics and timing.
